title: Logos 32 opening: NT florilegium: Son God by nature
english: Thirty-second discourse. Selections with syllogisms from the New Testament that the Son is God by nature, therefore neither made nor creature.
Pauline and Gospel lemmas are stacked so Christ is confessed God, not a creatural product.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
